'''Chapter 363''' is titled "Aqua Laguna".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Vol. 5: "Colors Trap: Yellow-Green of Friendship. Let's Go."

Set on her mission, [[Marianne|Miss Goldenweek]] tames a pterodactyl with a new Colors Trap, meaning to use it as transportation off of [[Little Garden]].

==Short Summary==
Nami and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] make their way towards the stuck [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] as the [[Aqua Laguna]] arrives.

==Long Summary==
The others watch as [[Nami]] makes her way down the stairs and leaps into the backstreets determined to save [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]. As they yell to her to come back, [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], who thought there was sea anemone coming out of a chimney, realizes that it is [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and makes his way towards him to the shock of the others. As the shipwrights are about to chase after them, they are stopped by [[Paulie]] who states that if they all go it would no longer be a rescue and that if someone has to help, it will be him. [[Chimney]] watches in amazement while [[Kokoro]] admits it is too late now as the wave is already close to the island.

[[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] finally reaches the chimney where Zoro is and Nami reaches as close a place to Luffy as she can and calls out to him. The wave continues to close in as she explains that [[Nico Robin|Robin]] is going to die to prevent them from being attacked. Once finding this out, Luffy grows more determined while Zoro gets Chopper to hand his other katana over.

The others watch in horror as the [[Aqua Laguna]] finally arrives about to cover everything underneath it, including the four [[Straw Hat Pirates]]. Just then, Luffy manages to push apart the buildings, grabs Nami and makes their way to a higher building. Zoro slices the chimney with 
'''[[Santoryu/Ittoryu|Sanjuroku Pound Ho]]''' just as Chopper uses '''[[Hito Hito no Mi|Jumping Point]]''' to get the pair to higher ground. As the four make it back to the bridge, they appear safe however, the Aqua Laguna crushes the bridge with its force.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Nami]] makes her way towards [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]], and [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] makes his way towards [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]].
**Nami tells Luffy about [[Nico Robin|Robin]]'s true intentions.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy]] and [[Roronoa Zoro]] have escaped.
**Luffy pushes apart the two buildings he was stuck between with his raw strength, and stretches to higher ground with Nami.
**Using [[Sandai Kitetsu]], which Chopper returned to him, Zoro slices the chimney he was stuck in using '''Sanjuroku Pound Ho'''.
**Chopper eats a [[Rumble Ball]] and uses '''Jumping Point''' to jump to higher ground with Zoro.
*[[Aqua Laguna]] has arrived and is right behind the four escaping [[Straw Hat Pirates|Straw Hats]].
